title: Early completion needs no confirmation; serviced Monday, invoiced later
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Make sure the schedule also holds a compliance service 'CVIP' (12-month term), and that unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' is enrolled with a CVIP certificate ending in about four months (for example End date 14 Feb 2027).
  4. Enroll unit 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' so PM-A reads Overdue. Create a work order for 403, press Add Service > Add on PM-A, and complete every PM-A line on the Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. On 402's Maintenance tab open CVIP's three-dot menu, choose Mark complete, choose Completed elsewhere, Reset date today, Start date today, Term 12 months, and press Mark complete. Watch for any warning or extra confirmation.
  2. On 403's work order press Mark complete on the PM-A row (its button now). Keep On a work order with this work order chosen and set Reset date to a Monday about three weeks ago (for example Mon 14 Sep 2026). Press Mark complete.
  3. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). Look for 403's PM-A row. Open 403's Maintenance tab and read PM-A.
  4. Back on the work order open the Finance tab, press Create Invoice and record the payment. Watch whether When was the maintenance done? lists PM-A.
  5. Read 403's PM-A on the Maintenance tab again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Completing CVIP four months early shows no warning and asks for no confirmation.
  • PM-A reads next due counts from 14 Sep 2026, so with Every 6 months its next due is Mar 2027.
  • The worklist shows nothing due for 403's PM-A.
  • Invoicing later changes nothing: the step after invoicing does not list PM-A (it was already reset), and PM-A still counts from 14 Sep 2026.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S18; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-E1: “Early completion is normal. Fleets move compliance work months earlier to fit a slow season, and nothing warns or confirms”
  • S18-E8: “A truck serviced on Monday and invoiced three weeks later is marked complete on Monday and counts its next cycle from Monday. The worklist shows nothing due for it in between, and invoicing later changes nothing”
  • S18-R8: “A service already reset by Mark complete is not listed: a service resets once”
